propositions.canonicalProposition: Barnfield's model inventory lists the candidate as developer of scorecard PL-APP-7, approved for production use on 14 February 2023 and live in the decision engine from 1 March 2023; the candidate prepared its release package.
propositions.rationale: The model risk office's letter, recorded in the HR verification note, gives the approval and live dates, and the resume describes the release package and the pre-rollout checks.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran out-of-time validation on twelve months of applications and documented Gini, calibration and stability results.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the validation and the write-up.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate produced monthly monitoring of population stability by score band and 90-day arrears by cohort after release.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the report and the work sample shows an extract of it.

expectedGap: Results were presented to the pricing working group; presentation to a credit committee is not documented.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the verified model-inventory record of the production approval and live date, the validation and the monitoring; describe the champion-challenger work as a simulation on historic applications.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate presented scorecard findings to a credit committee and in what capacity.
